title: 1999 HMMT February Team Problem 8
statement: Find all the roots of \(\left(x^{2}+3 x+2\right)\left(x^{2}-7 x+12\right)\left(x^{2}-2 x-1\right)+24=0\).

solutions.text: We re-factor as \((x+1)(x-3)(x+2)(x-4)\left(x^{2}-2 x-1\right)+24\), or \(\left(x^{2}-2 x-3\right)\left(x^{2}-\right.\) \(2 x-8)\left(x^{2}-2 x-1\right)+24\), and this becomes \((y-4)(y-9)(y-2)+24\) where \(y=(x-1)^{2}\). Now, \((y-4)(y-9)(y-2)+24=(y-8)(y-6)(y-1)\), so \(y\) is 1,6 , or 8 . Thus the roots of the original polynomial are \(0,2,1 \pm \sqrt{6}, 1 \pm 2 \sqrt{2}\).
